comment: Technology neutrality is appropriate at reference-architecture level, but several later requirements recommend or depend on particular technologies and standards, particularly FHIR. The relationship between technology neutrality and standards endorsement needs clarification.

anchor.note: p.64 l.Lines 568-571 read as the printed page; section 3.5.1 agrees

public.text: Technology neutrality is appropriate at reference-architecture level, but several later requirements recommend or depend on particular technologies and standards, particularly FHIR. The relationship between technology neutrality and standards endorsement needs clarification.
public.suggestedRevision: State that technology neutrality permits different conformant implementations, while the architecture may still specify mandatory or recommended open standards needed for interoperability and conformance.
